D.t: Nikki Budzinski leads by 14.0 in the forecast and wins 99% of simulations. The cushion is about 38,637 votes; a one point swing is about 1,378 voters changing sides.
In 8 of 10 simulations the result lands between D +6.3 and D +21.5. Only an unusual polling error changes the winner.
$2.9M cash against $25K. Spend it early on persuasion television in the battleground counties and keep a reserve for the last week.
